item.title: Master Salary Negotiation 💼 • Research market rates for your role and location. • Use: “Based on my research, the market rate is X.” • Highlight your achievements with quantifiable data. • Use: “I increased sales by 20% through Y strategy.” • Express enthusiasm for the role and company. How can you align your skills and achievements with the company's goals? #negotiation #careeradvice #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
